high_level_description: stc brand style, a moody minimalist photograph of an empty airport terminal lounge.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Floor-to-ceiling windows creating a black metal grid pattern, a polished reflective floor, and a hazy airport tarmac visible in the distance, subdued grayish lighting.

elements.desc: Rows of empty dark green airport lounge chairs, their silhouettes reflected on the glossy floor.
A solitary passenger seated in one of the chairs on the left side.
